cases.name: PDF visual wraps preserve joining dates and complete summary clauses

checks.actual: The employee must give 30 days notice before resignation. If the contract is terminated, access must be returned. This clause does not record an actual termination. The Employee is appointed as Senior Platform Engineer. Employment will commence on 14 August 2026. This fixed-term contract ends on 13 August 2028. The annual CTC includes variable compensation; reimbursements and the one-time joining bonus must not be added to the stated annual CTC.
